name: Livestream Overlay
summary: A frame around a live game or camera. It has a facecam slot, a chat panel, an alert box and a name bar. Neon edges and animated panels show that the stream is live.

philosophy.core_thesis: A live show needs a control room on screen: the frame holds every live signal in fixed slots, so the viewer always knows where to look.
design_principles: Divide the 1920x1080 frame into fixed slots: game 1440x810, facecam 360x270, chat 360x540 and a 1920x80 bar.
Frame each slot with a 2px line in the accent colour and cut corners at 45° for 12px.
Put a LIVE tag with a pulsing dot of 12px in the top-left corner at all times.
Set alert boxes at 480x120 with a 300ms slide-in and a 5s hold.
Show the latest follower, donation and subscriber in small mono labels of 14px to 18px.
Use a dark ground (#0E0E12) with one neon accent (#9146FF or #00F0A0) and a second colour for alerts only.
Keep the game slot free of overlays except the alert box and the LIVE tag.
anti_patterns: Soft, quiet layouts with no slots
Static panels with no live signal
Alert boxes that cover the game centre

layout.grid_mechanics: A 1920x1080 frame split into slots on a 24px grid: game, facecam, chat and a name bar; gutters are 12px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Under 10% of the frame is empty; slots fill the frame and gaps stay at 12px.
layout.alignment_rules: Slots align to the grid; the facecam sits at the frame bottom-left; the chat panel aligns to the right edge.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with 45° cut corners of 12px, 2px neon edges and corner ticks of 8px.

font_pairings.note: A squared, techno display face with a mono text face for stats.
A sharp display face for the name bar with a mono face for chat.
A condensed display face that fits long names in a small bar.

typography.tracking: Display takes +0.08em in capitals; labels take +0.12em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: medium (500) and bold (700).
Set the channel name in capitals at 32px in the name bar.
Set stat labels in mono at 14px.

color.palette_structure: Near-black with a purple or green neon accent and a red live signal.
color.contrast_rules: Signal white on control black holds at least 17:1; neon colours carry edges, tags and alerts, not body text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat dark panels with a 4% scanline layer and a thin neon edge.
color.light_and_shadow: A neon glow of 6px to 12px around active panels; no cast shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A screen-made control panel: flat dark glass with light edges, no real material.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px neon line at 100% on active panels and at 40% on idle panels; 45° cut corners.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Glow of 6px to 12px on live parts; the chat panel uses a 12px backdrop blur at 60% black.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 20px for follow, gift and subscribe; square terminals and a 2px edge.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Animated waveforms, rotating frames, particle bursts for alerts; no figurative illustration.

motion.transition_physics: Panels slide in over 300ms; the LIVE dot pulses at 1.2s per loop; alerts enter from the right, hold for 5s and leave over 300ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the neon glow from 6px to 12px; active state fills the edge colour for 120ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that something is happening now, with a crowd of others.

avoid_when: The content is not live or social.
The audience needs a calm reading page.
The frame has no room for fixed slots.

modifiers.how: Remove the slots, chat and alerts; keep one clean frame with a 24px lower-third.
Replace the facecam with an avatar on a pastel panel and round the corners to 24px.
Add HUD frames, glitch hover and acid-green data labels.

pack.why: A solid family with square terminals fits the cut-corner panels and the small alert marks.

ground.why: The ground is a dark control screen with scanlines, the room where a live show is run.
